9

Files

Reading and writing files with Odi domain

Feature Gate

Odi (the Odù of boundaries) governs filesystem operations and requires the database feature flag in your Ifa.toml.

Opening Files

Open File Handle 
// Open file (returns a handle)
ayanmo handle = Odi.si("data.txt");
// ... operations ...
Odi.pa();                    // close the handle

Reading Files

Reading a File 
// Read entire file as string
ayanmo content = Odi.ka("hello.txt");
Irosu.fo(content);

Writing Files

Writing a File 
// Write string to file (overwrites)
Odi.kọ("output.txt", "Hello, Ifá-Lang!");

Appending to Files

Appending 
// Append to file
Odi.fikun("log.txt", "New log entry");

Checking Files

File Checks 
// Check if file exists
ayanmo exists = Odi.wa("data.txt");  // otito or iro

// Delete file
Odi.pa_iwe("temp.txt");

What You Learned

  • Opening: Odi.si()
  • Reading: Odi.ka()
  • Writing: Odi.kọ()
  • Appending: Odi.fikun()
  • Existence: Odi.wa()
  • Closing: Odi.pa()
  • Deletion: Odi.pa_iwe()
  • Requires database feature flag
